decisions.reason: As a niche but close-to-core Magento template, it is somewhat vulnerable if uptake falls short of aspirations, yet its adjacency to hosting and shop support gives enough strategic fit to keep it for now.
A responsive website template is close to the firm’s established web project business, so with moderate organisational slack the firm would likely continue it while learning about demand.
Premium customer support directly builds on the firm’s strongest capabilities and recurring service model, so it is likely to meet or exceed aspiration levels relative to alternatives.
The software version management tool extends existing technical know-how and complements managed hosting operations, making retention likely despite normal early uncertainty.

The data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core offer, so if its early results are uncertain or below aspiration the firm would plausibly redeploy resources to its main platform and service development.
